title: Dangerously Yours
paragraphs: A dramatic anthology led by Victor Jory, presenting romantic adventure, historical drama, espionage, and literary stories in which love and danger are closely intertwined.

CBS romantic/adventure anthology starring Victor Jory. Historical corpus comprises two auditions plus sixteen numbered regular broadcasts. Frozen GRH set preserves both auditions and eleven regular broadcasts; regular programs 3, 4, 5, 15 and 16 are absent.

GRH documents the program through Pre-series auditions (June 20, 1944 to June 21, 1944) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] and CBS/Vicks regular run (July 2, 1944 to October 15, 1944) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Victor Jory (performer on 13 recordings), Jean Holloway (writer on 7 recordings and radio adaptor on 6 recordings), Mark Warnow (music director on 10 recordings and music on 2 recordings), Richard Sanville (director on 12 recordings), Gertrude Warner (performer on 6 recordings), [[person|jackson-beck|Jackson Beck]] (performer on 2 recordings), and Alfred Noyes (author on 1 recording).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include romantic adventure and doomed love, World War II-era commercial network radio, historical adventure, literary adaptation, heroic outlaw and swashbuckling figures, and Dangerously Yours to Matinee Theater production lineage.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Dangerously Yours 1944 CBS/Vicks run, Partial surviving Dangerously Yours corpus, Transition from Dangerously Yours to Matinee Theater, and Commercial network drama during World War II.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|matinee-theater|Matinee Theater]] (12 shared credited people), [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]] (6 shared credited people), [[show|the-mysterious-traveler|The Mysterious Traveler]] (6 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (6 shared credited people), and [[show|cloak-and-dagger|Cloak and Dagger]] (4 shared credited people).
